-- supabase/tests/bookmarks_privileges.test.sql — the privilege set `authenticated` holds
-- on public.bookmarks, exactly: the four verbs its policies admit and nothing else. The
-- sibling, for a table clients write, of the privilege-exactness assertion in
-- rls_structure.test.sql, and like it one row per (privilege) where what authenticated
-- HOLDS differs from what it SHOULD hold, so a stray TRUNCATE reds here exactly as a
-- missing SELECT does.
BEGIN;

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgtap WITH SCHEMA extensions;

SELECT plan(1);

SELECT is_empty(
  $$ SELECT priv
       FROM unnest(ARRAY['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE',
                         'TRUNCATE', 'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER']) AS priv
      WHERE has_table_privilege('authenticated'::name, 'public.bookmarks', priv)
            IS DISTINCT FROM (priv IN ('SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')) $$,
  'authenticated holds exactly SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE on public.bookmarks'
);

SELECT * FROM finish();

ROLLBACK;
